description: Survival Mode as it Should've Been

releases.notes:
### Changes
- Fix issue with bears swimming.
- Prevent double high blocks from breaking bedrock.
- Fix farmland temperature showing null below freezing.
- Fix an issue with squid spawning.
- Fix issues with berry bushes.
- Fix a rare crash with chunk data.
- Skip knife damage when scraping makes no progress.
- Fix client desync for loom progress.
- Updated the Portuguese localization.

### Changes

- Added Buoys and Lobster Traps. Bait traps with raw fish or mussels to catch lobsters and other critters. Buoys lower traps into deep water using rope.
- Seaweed found on beaches can now be heated into soda ash.
- When a pot holds ingredients that match both soup and another recipe, it now makes the other recipe.
- Tool racks can now be waterlogged in all fluids.
- Scraping no longer damages the knife when you click a spot that's already scraped, and Jade now shows what's being scraped. (#3753)
- Mobs no longer spawn on thatch. (#3682)
- Below y=0, temperature now gets warmer as you approach lava level. No more ice in lava caves...
- Updated hoe climate tooltip styling.
- Lobsters now look for traps in a smaller range (16 blocks, was 20).
- Updated the Simplified Chinese localization.
- You can take items off of querns while they're grinding something else.

### Fixes

- Fixed several kiln issues. (#3293)
- Fixes to tamed animal AI. (#3325)
- Fixed mold tables sometimes not rendering correctly after a chunk reloads. (#3598)
- Fixed rope anchors visually rotating with the placed rope (#3640), and rock rope anchors showing an extra rope while being thrown.
- Fixed water at the surface of enclosed atolls. (#3719)
- Fixed a missing texture on TFC armor with vanilla trim materials. (#3748)
- Fixed NeoForge block entity data not being saved. (#3754)
- Fixed advanced shapeless recipes in JEI. (#3755)
- Fixed a rare scraping crash. (#3758)
- Fixed the farmland temperature tooltip showing "null" below 0.
- Fixed a crash with banana plants.
- Fixed possible crashes when a firepit, forge, bloomery, blast furnace or firebox block was replaced.
- Fixed issues with underwater berry bushes.
- Fixed error when attempting to spawn squids, possibly.
- Fixed typo in Russian translation.
- Fixed some rare dupes/block interaction bugs.

### Changes
- Fix climbing crops able to break bedrock
- Fix cancelled squid spawns warning
- Fix issues with cranberry bushes and the spawning/spreading of berry bushes

### Changes
- Fix bucket duplicating waterlogged blocks (Closes #3688)
- Sync pot and crucible when filled via fluid capability (Closes #3713)
- Fix off-hand item being used when opening powder keg (Closes #3666)
- Fix crash in random animal growth (Closes #3391)
- Fix crash when chiseling while dead (Closes #3395)
- Fix crash placing tall plants below existing plants (Closes #3589)
- Fix tall berry bush field guide showing rainfall instead of hydration (Closes #3735)
- Fix mobs sinking in salt and spring water (Closes #3398)

### Changes
- Added more info to inventory tab tooltips (#3729)
- Show the survival inventory tabs in creative mode (#3728)
- Barrel dyeing recipes for terracotta now use plain terracotta as the input, allowing you to make white terracotta (#3714)
- Welding recipes no longer display an anvil tier requirement in JEI/EMI when they have no minimum tier (#3695)
- Flower cuttings now display all possible flowers in JEI/EMI instead of an empty item (#3736)
- Exposed `airTicks` on more devices (#3734)

### Fixes
- Fix a crash with bamboo (#3704)
- Fix the Globe Trotter advancement being impossible to complete in some cases (#3722)
- Fix javelins not dealing variable thrown damage (#3724)
- Fix several field guide typos (#3715)
- Fix the berry bush config item (#3731)
- Fix prey animals not fleeing from predators (#3726) (#3727)
- Fix crushing damage (#3725)
- Fix firepits consuming fuel while the calendar is paused (#3733)
- Fix plants rendering in their non-blooming state outside the world, such as in the field guide or in JEI/EMI (#3186)
- Fix a crash when using Vivecraft (most likely)
- Fix incorrect Rankine calculation (#3738)
- Fix falling blocks getting stuck on boats (#3700)
- Fix an issue with addons/other mods adding food items and it crashing with creative tabs (#3711)

Version 2.2.33

### Fixes

- Fix `doDaylightCycle` being set to `false` in rare situations.

- Closes #1878 , an anvil desync issue introduced by the last update
- Closes #1861 , made the despawning behavior of old animals more predictable in edge cases
- A jute net now processes double the amount of olive oil as previously. This was done so that it is possible to process full barrels of olive oil.

Version 2.0.11-alpha

### Changes

An emergency build has been developed to fix some game breaking bugs.
- Fix fishing rod rendering string on wrong side
- Add chest recipe
- Add support beam recipe
- Add loot table for peat
- Fix not being able to put anything in the composter
- Fix broken lang entries for paths
- Composter changes shape based on fullness
- Fix placing charcoal inside your body
- Charcoal is now view blocking / suffocating
- Fix being able to get compost before completion

Version 2.0.7-alpha

### Changes

Lots of bugfixes in this one, several in relation to dedicated server functionality. (it should like... run now, at least. And not be plagued with catastrophic desync issues... in theory)

- Add missing recipes for ceramic molds
- Added missing ingot mold knapping recipe.
- Fix an issue due to block and ingredient type registration causing dedicated server disconnects.
- Fix numerious synchronization issues, i.e. fuel or ore tooltips not appearing on dedicated server.
- Fix synchronization issues with temperature display on items
- Fix small vessels not showing temperature on client.
- Fix synchronization issues with temperature and food changes in items.
- Fix broken `/reload` command.
- Add the green/gray rotten food overlay
- Fix servers sometimes having ghost waterlogged blocks based on initialization order.
- Coal ores (lignite and bituminious) now burn.
- Fix (some) foods decaying in the creative inventory.
- Fix a possible integer overflow in max alloy calculation.
- Logs not placed by the player break slower (aka trees).
- Add sapling drops to leaves, which are customized based on the tree.
- Fix removing a firepit attachment duplicating items
- Stripped wood and logs are now usable in anything else that accepts logs, notably fire pit creation, and also behave properly when trying to cut down a tree (stripping preserves the 'natural' property of the tree, and will all cut down at once)
- Quern doesn't allow invalid grinding
- Add cooking recipes for meat and some edible plants
- Fixed emergent plants not generating (like cattails)
- Fixed floating plants not generating (like lilly pads)
- Re-added quern targeting block highlights
- Make log pile inventory work again
- Closing the inventory after knapping properly updates the client knapping stack
- Anvils and lamps no longer create black holes or hawking radiation
- Fixed missing texture errors from crucible models
- Make steam particles visible
- Fixed quern making missing particles when grinding.
- Quern now drops itself when broken
- Touched up some consistiency issues with fire starters, flint and steel, and lighting devices (fire pit and forge). Fixes the "light for one tick" weirdness, desyncs on client, not consuming durability, and just general weirdness and inconsistiency.
- Fixed crucible's tooltip showing "0 mB of Air"
- Fixed a couple more block entities not dropping their contents, or saving them, as expected.

Boom! A new build has exploded!

About explosions, why not use it to mine ores? Yeah you got that right powderkegs are in!

**(Some) collapse mechanics from 1.15 have been backported**
- Collapses can now occur in supported areas, if the collapse *starts* at an unsupported position.
- Collapses travel upwards from the epicenter, causing secondary collapses a short time later.


**Changelog**:
- Added powderkegs
- Added sulfur ore generation
- Added korean translation
- Added stick storage akin to log piles
- Changes in collapse mechanic
- Immature dead crops have it's own texture
- Fixed #1374 you can move olive oil with buckets
- Fixed #1327 animals now will try to avoid burning themselves
- Stone anvils now have the same properties as the raw rock variant: falls and is slow to mine (Closes #1390)
- Added missing ore dict "terracotta" to stained ones, which fixed heat capability (Closes #1343).
- Animal Spawn Count renamed to Animal Respawn Count (Closes #1384).
- Fixed hwyla title not being overriden (Closes #1370).
- Fixed Donkeys and Mules not rendering chests (Closes #1355).
- Chested animals won't drop chests on death (Closes #1394).
- Wolves and Ocelots now grow old (Closes #1354).
- Added config to change the pouring speed accept by crucible (Closes #1330).
- Fixed some more unintended uses for rotten food (Closes #1397).
- Added overburdened potion effect to donkeys and mules when carrying more than one heavy item (Closes #1369). Note: There's a mojang bug where potion effects does not matter when riding entities.
